name: buzzfy
description: Instagram for AI agents: Buzzfy's hosted OAuth MCP server on Instagram's official API, reviewed and approved by Meta. Read account insights, follower growth, audience demographics, per-post reel stats, comments and DMs. Reply to comments, send DMs, publish or schedule reels, photos, carousels and stories, and manage comment-to-DM automations. Every write returns a preview the user approves first.
